public.text: The section suggests that profiles give practical form to the architecture, but it does not define the relationship among a reference profile, national profile, implementation guide, vendor implementation, and conformance statement.
public.suggestedRevision: Define this hierarchy and show how requirements are progressively constrained from the global reference architecture to national specifications and tested product implementations.
